summary: Quote on NIFTY (NSE_INDEX, instrument 26000 on segment 1): a 1501 event with its quote nested in Touchline becomes an index Quote frame with open, high, low and the previous close.

notes: An index frame carries no trade-size or book fields (feed/protocol/market.rs shown_quote).

No recorded 1501-json-full settles where its quote sits: the desktop's XTS fixtures are built, not captured (tests/fixtures/brokers/fivepaisaxts/stream.json quote_1501), the template web adapter reads 1501 at the root ('data is at root level', ibulls_adapter.py:775), and RMoney's reads Touchline when present ('Some payloads embed quote fields under Touchline, others send flat keys', rmoney_adapter.py:901, and its 1501 fallback looks in Touchline, :841-845). The case pins both shapes; a live capture of a 1501-json-full decides which the template's zeros come from.

deviations.reason: With the 1501 quote nested in Touchline (the shape of this case) this web adapter reads 1501 at the message root ('data is at root level', :775) and sends average_price as 0: a wrong value, lost data. The desktop reads Touchline when the message has one, else the root, so it is right whichever shape XTS sends (quote_root and index_quote_root pin the root shape, which matches). Which shape a real 1501-json-full has is for the maintainer's market-hours check; this deviation holds when XTS nests the quote (lead ruling 2026-11-09).

The desktop sends an index's change worked out from its previous close; this web adapter sends none, and the lead's rule (index price_change per adapter) leaves it out. The dialect has no switch for an index's change yet (feed/dialect/names.rs Dialect::instrument_change covers other instruments only): asked of lane wire through the lead.
